report_comment.text: ETV6 encodes an ETS-family transcriptional repressor with an amino-terminal oligomerization domain. PDGFRB encodes platelet-derived growth factor receptor beta, a receptor tyrosine kinase. ETV6::PDGFRB is a recognized fusion in myeloid/lymphoid neoplasms with tyrosine-kinase gene fusions, often associated with eosinophilia. Imatinib can induce durable hematologic, cytogenetic and molecular remissions in ETV6::PDGFRB-associated myeloid/lymphoid neoplasms.
